minimum_evidence_requirements_for_correc: Direct request payload showing client-submitted amount_cents (e.g., 1000000) for the candidate's create request timestamp
Authoritative external source (import file, payment gateway record) that records the smaller unit amount
Reproducible frontend bug report with code/build id and matching timestamps linking a frontend ×100 scaling bug to these events
Or explicit human confirmation from the account owner/operator after verifying records
If request-body logs are not available, at least one independent authoritative corroborating source is required before correction
